problem.title: Why managing multiple client streams drains your day.

items.title: 5–15 client streams — one head
items.body: You jump from a strategy sync with Client A to a review with Client B. By afternoon, the specifics and verbal agreements of the morning calls are fading.

items.title: Decisions vanish in transit
items.body: You agreed on a scope pivot or moved a milestone during the call. Because it wasn't documented immediately, client expectations drift.

items.title: Post-call administrative drag
items.body: Writing summaries, creating tasks, and updating deadlines across multiple project boards burns 30+ minutes of manual typing every day.

items.title: Evening context reconstruction
items.body: At the end of the day, you're left digging through notepad scraps and chat tabs trying to remember what was promised to whom.

problem.closing: This isn't a discipline issue. It is the cost of high context switching without an automated operational memory.

transformation.title: The post-call loop.

items.question: How does the post-call follow-up workflow work?
items.answer: Immediately after a client call, open Logitaka Talk and speak what was agreed (actions, deadlines, key decisions). In 30–60 seconds, Logitaka parses your speech into draft cards mapped to the right client project. You review the cards on screen, make any verbal adjustments, and click Confirm to apply them.

items.question: Does it modify my client projects while I speak?
items.answer: No. Everything displayed while speaking is an isolated draft. Nothing touches your client workspaces until you explicitly hit Apply — then Logitaka executes the exact reviewed batch deterministically, with no second AI pass.

items.question: Can I mention multiple clients in a single voice session?
items.answer: Yes. Logitaka can route distinct tasks and decisions to different client projects in a single session (e.g. "For Acme Corp, send proposal on Thursday; for Beta Studio, review budget tomorrow").

items.question: What if I miss a detail or want to correct a date?
items.answer: Corrections happen in place. Simply say "Actually, set the Acme deadline to Friday" and the card updates immediately without duplicating.

items.question: How is client data protected and isolated?
items.answer: Every client project maintains isolated context. We do not use your private client data or notes to train public models. All transmissions and storage use enterprise-grade encryption.

items.question: Who is Logitaka best suited for?
items.answer: Independent consultants, fractional operators (CTO/CMO/COO), boutique agency leads, and advisors running 5 to 15 parallel client engagements who need to eliminate post-call administrative overhead.

items.question: What plans include the Talk voice workspace?
items.answer: Logitaka Talk is included in every plan — Starter (up to 5 projects), Pro (up to 10 projects + Structured Meetings), and Premium (unlimited projects + Risk Radar).
